scope: G3 functional branch only: the windows of every later index phase run through C, and one Publish writes an index generation and NV-selects it, with the C history from the job's Start as its provenance, in a real migrated V2 store with cold replays; no production caller, produced image, GWIN0 package, installed run or native C activation

branch_policy.owner_decision: On 29 October 2026 the owner kept further sequence-19 G2 testing and GWIN0 completion on feature/g3-gwin0-beta and moved G3 functional development to this branch in the words: complete G3 in a different branch till we fully test G2 and complete GWIN0. This checkpoint is the next step of that work; no separate owner approval of it is claimed

implementation: run_index_phase_direct (direct/worker/index_run.rs) now runs a selected window of every phase. On the Advance snapshot it admitted only an ingest window. The Statistics, Covariance, Projection, Vectors and Audit boundaries each refuse a job other than the C-selected one. Covariance, Projection, Vectors and Audit also refuse a commitment that differs from the reviewed window, then bind it. Statistics charges its pages through the page reserve and debit that the preparation reviewed

WindowCommitment holds the one commitment a window reaches. The store binds it after writing and again after replay, and a second, different commitment is refused. It cannot be bound before the reserved objects are

publish_index_generation_direct takes a prepared Publish request and the installation's fixed builder. The window writes the generation manifest as one more metadata blob beside the next job and the candidate, reads all three back and compares them with the verified window. The PhaseSelection record (domain luma-c-index-phase-selection-v1) gains a generation field, which a Publish must carry and every other window must leave out. One NV dispatch selects it and the owner leaf then names the generation as current

Provenance: before a generation is reserved, verify_chain (direct/worker/index_chain.rs) requires the builder to equal the audited job's. It then walks the C descriptors from the current one back to the job's Start. Each event that selected a job for this owner is read as a ChainLink (index/effects/chain.rs), a Start, window or Advance record that derives that job again from the one before it. The newest job must be the audited job. Each earlier descriptor must be the exact full frame its successor committed to. The walk is bounded at 4096 events and four C read budgets, and a longer history refuses publication
A plain window run has no builder, so its generation boundary refuses. Every later generation boundary (release and current generation) still refuses

Parent growth: job namespaces are created under the tails parent, which gains one directory entry per direct event and, after about 56 events, another block. The parent allocation delta is now luma-c-direct-tails-parent-allocation-v5 over the tails parent. Every other existing C directory must keep its allocated blocks
selected_index_generation reads the generation the selected owner leaf names, and the cold phase replay rebuilds that leaf with the published generation
The test owner holds two artifacts, so ingestion takes two windows and the corpus has two records

production_change.parent_allocation: rust/luma-platform/src/content_custody/v2_publication/parent_allocation.rs: Delta::validate, which production StorageSelection::validate calls, now accepts only schema 5 with the domain luma-c-direct-tails-parent-allocation-v5 and refuses the v4 attempts-parent delta. production_change.metadata: rust/luma-platform/src/content_index/observed/metadata.rs: MetadataWriteSet gains a generation field. It is always serialised, so every extension's canonical bytes now carry "generation":null and its digest changes. A named generation must share the next job's binding and hold 1 to MAX_INDEX_PAGE_BYTES bytes, else "index metadata extension names an outsized generation". prepare_metadata, which writes the manifest of a Publish, remains dead code in production builds

exact_metadata_inventory_is_closed_bounded_owner_bound_data: a generation with the next job's reference is accepted, and a generation of another owner generation or one byte over MAX_INDEX_PAGE_BYTES is refused. The test asserts only that each is an error
test_behaviour: New test actual_index_phases_run_through_c_and_publish_one_generation, beside the seven index tests of the Advance snapshot. Each case needs every step before it, so it is one test. With the two new unit tests the build holds 1638 platform tests, up from 1635
The owner holds two artifacts. Two ingestion windows run and the first leaves ingestion open. An Advance selects Statistics

Statistics: a window of another size is refused while planning. Over the C-selected job a run with no preparation, a run whose base is the ingest job and a run of a different window are each refused with no NV dispatch and an unchanged store inventory, and so is a second run of the window just selected

Every further Statistics window runs until the phase is complete, at most 8. The first that writes pages also proves 24 forged cuts of the selected page window against the cold phase-selection verifier. refusal_cases gives each text

An Advance selects each later phase, and its windows run until complete: Covariance one document a window, Projection one pair and then one wide window, Vectors one document a window and Audit one bounded window. Covariance, Vectors and Audit each take 2 windows

After Audit, another Advance is refused because publication is reviewed separately. The Publish is prepared, then refused as a plain window run and refused under another builder, each with no NV dispatch and an unchanged store inventory

The Publish under the audited job's builder takes one NV dispatch. A cold reopen names the generation, the preparation is resolved and the physical accounting equals the measured inventory. The job read through its selected reference is Stage::Published. The generation blob is the manifest's canonical bytes and its digest is the manifest's
VerifiedGeneration::open accepts the generation, and lexical AND queries answer over both retained artifacts: "distinct" matches 1 and "retained" matches 2, neither truncated
The same Publish again is refused because no unresolved preparation remains, and a cold reopen still selects the publication
